article.title: Brent crude climbs to a five-month high on tightening OPEC+ supply
article.text: Brent crude settled at a five-month high after OPEC+ signalled it would hold production cuts through the next quarter, tightening global supply as demand stayed resilient. Traders said the move reflected genuine tightness rather than a speculative squeeze.
article.note: Blueprint §3's own canonical example, pinned in isolation: ONGC has a genuinely DIRECT economic mechanism to crude (upstream realization moves near one-for-one with the benchmark) -- but the article never names ONGC as its own subject, so the only evidence connecting it to this event is the curated knowledge-registry archetype (tier D). A strong, directly-transmitted mechanism does not buy back a weak evidence tier: D caps at secondary_ripple regardless of how direct or material the story is.
